## File: facebookresearch_fastText/python/fasttext_module/fasttext/util/util.py

Prompts

```
["test predictions against labels to compute precision and recall using fastText's test function", 'find the nearest neighbor vector to a query vector within a set of candidate vectors', "reduce a fastText model's input and output matrices using PCA to a target dimension", "download pre-trained common-crawl word vectors for a given language id from fastText's website", "review the set of valid language ids supported by fastText's pre-trained common-crawl models"]
```

Usage

```
{'test_predictions': "test predictions against labels to compute precision and recall using fastText's test function", 'find_nearest_neighbor': 'find the nearest neighbor vector to a query vector within a set of candidate vectors', 'reduce_model': "reduce a fastText model's input and output matrices using PCA to a target dimension", 'download_model': "download pre-trained common-crawl word vectors for a given language id from fastText's website", 'review_valid_lang_ids': "review the set of valid language ids supported by fastText's pre-trained common-crawl models"}
```
